description: bstack governance hooks. Paths self-locate via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they survive reinstalls and are invisible to the skills CLI. The two hooks that WRITE <workspace>/.control UNCONDITIONALLY (knowledge-wakeup via leverage-ship-sensor; leverage-sensor at Stop) run through bstack-hook-guard.sh, which no-ops them outside a bstack-governed workspace so this personal-scope plugin never pollutes non-bstack repos. arc-continuation + autonomous-posture are session-scoped, self-guarding, and write nothing to the workspace, so they run unwrapped (wrapping them would false-negative the loop-stall logic when cwd is a nested non-governed repo). ask-origin-stamp-hook.sh also writes under <workspace>/.control (an ask's origin: block) but is NOT wrapped: its own bash-only prefilter (PASEO_AGENT_ID set, AND the raw tool-call JSON mentions `.control/asks/*.yaml`) already guarantees the path exists before python3 is even spawned, so the guard's `.control`-exists check would be a strictly redundant git spawn on every Write/Edit/MultiEdit in every session. l3-stability is source-guarded internally. test-lock-hook fail-opens on internal error (`bstack test-lock verify` in CI is the backstop). bstack-autoupdate is workspace-agnostic (global). session-loops-hook.py (BRO-2932) records a session's crons on <BROOMVA_HOME>/ledger/loops/session.jsonl for Maestro's ORPHANED/EXPIRING checks; it writes nothing to the workspace and nothing at all for a session that never had a cron, so it runs unwrapped, as an isolated (-I) interpreter with no bash in front (it fires on every Stop and prompt; budget p95 < 50 ms), and `|| true` keeps even a missing interpreter from surfacing as a hook error. bg-task-stop-guard.py (BRO-2815) runs unwrapped as an isolated (-I) interpreter: it writes nothing to the workspace (its per-session cap state lives under $BROOMVA_AUTONOMOUS_HOME), it allows every stop unless PASEO_AGENT_ID is set, and it must NOT carry `|| true`, because its block is exit 2. Primitive map: SessionStart = P6 knowledge-wakeup + P7 autoupdate; Stop = P19 arc-continuation + BRO-2815 bg-task-stop-guard (under Paseo, refuses a turn-end while the session's own background task is in flight; one block per turn, five per session) + loop-sensor + BRO-2932 session-loops snapshot; SessionEnd = BRO-2932 session-loops ended; UserPromptSubmit = P19 autonomous-posture + BRO-2932 session-loops cron-fire correlation; PreToolUse = L3-G0 gate + P11 test-lock (blocks edits to tests committed under a Test-Lock: trailer); PostToolUse = BRO-2918 ask-origin-stamp (runs `ask_ledger.py stamp` on every Write/Edit/MultiEdit of a `.control/asks/*.yaml` file, so a new ask always names the session that raised it — never blocks; a stamp failure is swallowed) + BRO-2932 session-loops cron_created/cron_deleted (matcher CronCreate|CronDelete).
